name: JavaScript: JSA-41-01 Certified Associate JavaScript Programmer (JS Institute)
material_vintage: OpenEDG JS Institute JSA-41-01 exam syllabus (status ACTIVE), fetched live on 2026-09-26 from jsinstitute.org/jsa-exam-syllabus and itemised in full. Exam format: 40 items; pass = cumulative 70%; block weights 25/23/27/25%. The JS Institute publishes no past papers: every item is original. Exam-dump sites were not used. Every code-output answer key was generated by running the code in Node.js 22 (dates use UTC so results don't depend on time zone; network examples run against a local server started inside the snippet; XMLHttpRequest is browser-only and is taught for the browser console).
level_source: standalone: a vendor certification with no RQF/FHEQ level
